name: ResultEntities
description:
A list of entities as compact rows: glyph with status, name (a context link), a data
detail, the state, and the row ⋯ menu — with the same menu on right-click (R11.6).

props.name: result
props.type: ResultBase & { type: "entities"; entities: Array<import("../types.js").EntityRef & { detail?: string; }>; total?: number; }
props.description: The entity-list result: the `entities` shown as rows, each with an optional `detail`, and `total` for the count (defaults to the number of entities).
